Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure.
Senior leaders from UnitedHealth Group Incorporated (the "Company") will respond to questions in an interview format, including discussion of the Company’s strategy, market positions, recent results and expectations for its end markets, at the Barclays 28
th
Annual Global Healthcare Conference on Tuesday, March 10, 2026, beginning at 11:30 a.m., Eastern Time. 
A live audio webcast of the presentation will be made available through the Investor Relations page of the Company’s website at 
www.unitedhealthgroup.com
.
